classification.difficultyReason: Combine equal-radius isosceles triangle angles with the perpendicular tangent–radius property.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Circle with centre O, bottom contact T, horizontal tangent extending both ways to P on the right, two radii and their joining chord. The central angle is 80 degrees; x is between OT and the chord, and y is between the chord and the rightward tangent.
spec.mathematics: The two radii form an isosceles triangle with vertex angle 80 degrees. The tangent is perpendicular to OT.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 80-degree angle and unknown labels x and y are visible; supplied numerical answers are excluded.

answer.worked:
The two radii are equal, so the base angles are equal.
$$\begin{align*}2x+80^\circ&=180^\circ\\2x&=100^\circ\\x&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
The tangent is perpendicular to the radius at $T$.
$$\begin{align*}y&=90^\circ-50^\circ\\y&=40^\circ\end{align*}$$
